GenAI Developer
Disabilities:
Visually Impaired
Chennai / Hybrid
Hearing Impaired
Job Type - Full Time
Locomotor Disability
4+ Years experience
Read More
You will be responsible for developing, designing and maintaining cutting-edge AI-based conversation system, ensuring smooth and engaging user experiences.

Roles & Responsibilities 1.Working across client team to develop and architect Generative AI solutions using ML & GenAI. 2.Developing and promoting standards for PwD (Persons with Disabilities) community.
3.Selecting appropriate AI tools and Machine Learning models for tasks.
4.Training the team members on Python and other open-source technologies.
5.Be part of client strategy team and to provide thought leadership team on the future of GenAI.

Qualifications 1.Engineering Graduates preferably on Computer Science/Electronics.
2.4+ years of overall experience.
3.2+ years working experience on Python or R.
4.Must have worked on programs/projects with minimum team size of 10.
5.Good understanding of GenAI engineering, Implementation and Tools.
